text: Given a Recorder stub for PUT computers/42 returning an updated computer record, When immybot_computers_set_primary_user(computerId=42, primaryPersonId=7) is called, Then the outbound request is a PUT to computers/42 with body {"primaryPersonId": 7, "providerLinkUpdates": []}, and the tool returns the stubbed updated record (including primaryPersonId: 7).

Given the same stub, When immybot_computers_set_primary_user(computerId=42, primaryPersonId=7, onboardingStatus="Completed") is called, Then the outbound body includes "onboardingStatus": "Completed".
Given the same stub, When immybot_computers_set_primary_user(computerId=42, primaryPersonId=7, additionalPersonIds=[8, 9]) is called, Then the outbound body includes "additionalPersonIds": [8, 9].

Given the same stub, When immybot_computers_set_primary_user(computerId=42, primaryPersonId=7) is called with no optional arguments, Then the outbound body contains exactly primaryPersonId and providerLinkUpdates -- no onboardingStatus or additionalPersonIds key at all.

Given a Recorder stub for PUT computers/999 returning HTTP 404, When immybot_computers_set_primary_user(computerId=999, primaryPersonId=7) is called, Then the tool returns the structured error envelope with ImmyBot's literal message, and does not raise.

Given the tool's registered description (as returned by tools/list), When it is read, Then it mentions setting the primary user / onboarding status / linked users, states "only when the user explicitly asks", and states the caller must already know the person id.

Given tools/list's schema for immybot_computers_set_primary_user, When the required-parameters set is inspected, Then it is exactly {"computerId", "primaryPersonId"} (matches tests/test_tools.py's test_required_params, run via the EXPECTED_TOOLS entry).

Given a real ImmyBot tenant, an existing computer id, and a valid person id, When an agent calls immybot_computers_set_primary_user against the live instance, Then the call succeeds and a subsequent immybot_computers_get(computerId) shows the new primaryPersonId.
steps: Obtain ImmyBot credentials for a real tenant, plus a known computer id and a known valid person id
Call immybot_computers_get(computerId=<id>) and read its primaryPerson/primaryPersonId field
expect: The set call returns the updated record with the new primaryPersonId and no error; the follow-up get confirms the same primaryPersonId persisted
evidence: needs a real vendor account (mcp-track.md 2.5/3): no ImmyBot tenant/credentials in this design-time environment; does not block 6b per mcp-track.md 3 completion criteria
